_meta.scope: All 20 2026/27 Premier League clubs. Regular-time and extra-time penalties are weighted above shootouts; same-pitch events are weighted above absence-only events; official club and competition reports are weighted above local press, specialist projections and career databases.

status_values.verified_unchanged: Recommended order matches the filed order and has adequate current support.
status_values.unchanged_contested: Recommended order matches the filed order, but same-pitch evidence is split, delegated or otherwise non-decisive.
status_values.unchanged_projected: Recommended order matches the filed order but remains a preseason projection without a complete current same-pitch test.
status_values.change_required: Recommended order differs materially from the filed order.
status_values.change_required_transfer_conditional: Recommended order differs and at least one position is exposed to a live transfer condition.

_meta.important_non_order_correction: Arsenal's filed note says Gyokeres' recent penalty came while Saka was absent. That is not true of the 20 December 2025 Everton event: both started and Gyokeres took. Saka had taken against West Ham with Gyokeres present on 4 October 2025, so the evidence supports a player-led, situational split rather than a clean absence-only deputy event.

clubs.rationale: Saka converted against West Ham with Gyokeres on the pitch, then Gyokeres converted the decisive Everton penalty with Saka on the pitch. Reporting around the Everton event indicates Arsenal let the players decide and used the kick to restore Gyokeres' confidence. The current specialist order still puts Saka first, so retain Saka-Gyokeres-Odegaard but describe the top two as situational and correct the filed absence claim.

clubs.rationale: Marco Silva said Robinson was selected to take at Wolves when first-choice Raul Jimenez was off the pitch; Robinson converted with Lukic, Iwobi and Muniz in the side, and the current specialist table lists Robinson alone after Jimenez and Harry Wilson departed. Lukic is the best practical second choice because he has prior regular-time senior penalty experience; Muniz is the practical tertiary as the current centre-forward, but neither backup has current Fulham assignment evidence. Alvaro Arbeloa replaced Silva on 7 July, so the entire order remains provisional until his staff makes a competitive assignment.
transfer_conditions: Any incoming established penalty taker should trigger an immediate re-audit; the new Arbeloa staff has not yet supplied a competitive hierarchy test.
